units.source_text: 那时候，我刚遇见你，还没有向你明确地倾吐我的爱慕之情。

en.t: At that time, I had only just met you, and had not yet clearly poured out my feelings of love for you.

units.source_text: 按照当时的习惯，如今我全神凝视着含苞待放的红梅，一动也不动。

en.t: Following the custom of those days, I now gaze with all my being at the red plum blossoms about to open, without moving at all.

units.source_text: 我不知你在何方，可我的灵魂恍如肉眼看不见的波浪或者激流，奔向离开了尘世的你前去的地方。

en.t: I do not know where you are, yet my soul, like waves or a torrent invisible to the naked eye, rushes toward the place where you, having left this world behind, have gone.

units.source_text: 我依旧是那样深切地思念着你。

en.t: I still miss you with that same deep longing.
